evaluation.title: NIST Atomic Spectra Database: Ground States and Ionization Energies
evaluation.scope: Returned ground-state rows only; not independent verification of all underlying papers

interpretation.scope: Ground-state isolated atoms and positive atomic ions; not solid-state work functions, solution redox potentials, optical line wavelengths or isotope-resolved thresholds.
interpretation.unbracketed: Evaluated unbracketed ASD energy; no blanket claim of a direct measurement.
interpretation.square_brackets: Interpolation, extrapolation or semiempirical procedure relying on experimental values.
interpretation.parentheses: Ab initio or otherwise not derived from evaluated experimental data.
interpretation.configuration: Largest component of a calculated ground-level eigenvector; source notation and uncertainty of assignment retained.
interpretation.uncertainty: Exact displayed NIST eV uncertainty retained; no confidence level or missing uncertainty invented.
interpretation.source_names: NIST source element names are retained as provenance; the MAT parent name remains canonical, including Aluminium.
interpretation.missing: UNKNOWN means no row or numeric energy in this snapshot, not evidence that the quantity is inapplicable.

calculations.scope: Energy-equivalent frequency and vacuum wavelength, not emission lines, universal element frequencies or recoil-corrected photoionisation thresholds. Input theoretical and semiempirical status remains attached. Floating-point digits do not add precision.

energy_equivalents.uncertainty_method: Frequency: exact linear propagation; wavelength: first-order propagation of source uncertainty. Constants exact by SI definition. No new confidence level assigned.
